title: 再 (zài) in Chinese: HSK 1 Grammar with Examples
description: How to use 再 (zài) in Chinese: "again", "one more" and "then" for future actions, 不要再 and 再也不, the 再 vs 又 mistake, and HSK 1 examples.
lede: 再 (zài) goes before a verb and talks about something that has not happened yet: doing it again, doing a bit more, or doing it later, after something else. You already know it from 再见, "see you again".

paras: Subject + 再 + verb. 再 always comes before the verb, never at the end of the sentence as "again" does in English. If there is a word like 能 or 想, 再 goes after it and directly before the main verb.
Adding 一下 or doubling the verb (看看, 问问) makes the request sound lighter and more polite. 请再说一下 is the phrase to use when you didn't catch what someone said.

examples.en: Could you say that again, please?

examples.zh: 我不认识这个字，你能再写一下吗？
examples.py: Wǒ bú rènshi zhège zì, nǐ néng zài xiě yíxià ma?
examples.en: I don't know this character. Could you write it again?

paras: With food, drink and shopping, 再 means "some more" or "another". It is often followed by 一点儿 or a number and measure word. Hosts in China say 你再吃一点儿吧 all the time.

examples.py: Wǒ hái xiǎng zài hē yìdiǎnr shuǐ.
examples.en: I'd like a little more water.

paras: 再 can also mean "then" or "only after that". The first action comes first in the sentence, often with 了, and 再 introduces the second one: 吃了饭再去 means "go after we've eaten".
On its own with a time word, 再 puts something off until later. 明天再说 ("let's talk about it tomorrow") is a polite way to stop a conversation or delay a decision.

examples.py: Chī le fàn zài qù ba.

examples.zh: 你到了家再给我打电话。
examples.py: Nǐ dào le jiā zài gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: Call me when you get home.

examples.zh: 我现在很忙，下午再给你打电话。
examples.py: Wǒ xiànzài hěn máng, xiàwǔ zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: I'm busy right now. I'll call you this afternoon.

examples.zh: 我今天不去了，明天再去。
examples.py: Wǒ jīntiān bú qù le, míngtiān zài qù.
examples.en: I'm not going today. I'll go tomorrow.

examples.py: Hǎo de, wǒmen míngtiān zài shuō.
examples.en: OK, let's talk about it tomorrow.

paras: 不要再 + verb + 了 tells someone to stop doing something, or not to do it again. 不想再 + verb says you don't want to do it again. 再也不 is stronger: "never again".
In questions, 再 stays in front of the verb: 你能不能再说一下? Note the tone change: 不 becomes bú before a fourth tone, as in 不要 búyào.

examples.py: Nǐ búyào zài kàn shǒujī le.
Wǒ bù xiǎng zài qù nàr le.
examples.en: I don't want to go there again.

examples.py: Tā shuō tā zài yě bù xiǎng lái le.
examples.en: She said she never wants to come again.

examples.py: Yào bu yào zài mǎi yí ge?

sections.h2: The most common mistake: 再 is for the future
paras: 再 is only for repeats that haven't happened yet: plans, requests and suggestions. For something that already happened again, Chinese uses a different word, 又 (yòu), which you will meet at HSK 3. So "He came again yesterday" is 他昨天又来了, not 他昨天再来了.
A quick test: if the English sentence is about the past ("came again", "was late again"), don't use 再.

examples.zh: 我不在家，你晚上再来吧。
examples.py: Wǒ bú zài jiā, nǐ wǎnshang zài lái ba.
examples.en: I'm not at home. Come back this evening.

worksheet.title: 再 (zài) Worksheet: HSK 1 Printable with Answers
worksheet.description: A free printable 再 (zài) worksheet for HSK 1: 18 exercises (word order with 再, fix the mistake) with an answer key.

exercises.instructions: Write the words as one correct sentence. Remember: 再 goes directly before the verb.

items.en: Could you read it again, please?
We'll go and see a film after we've eaten.
answers: 我们吃了饭再去看电影。
吃了饭我们再去看电影。

items.en: I'd like to have another look.

exercises.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.en: I'd like a bit more rice.
Let's go back after we've eaten.

items.zh: 我现在不在家，晚上给你打电话再。
items.en: I'm not at home now. I'll call you this evening.
answers: 我现在不在家，晚上再给你打电话。
